summary: Use a Link to send people to related content, such as terms, help, or a recovery step, on its own line or inside a sentence.

useWhen.text: Send people to related content, such as terms, help, or a recovery step, on its own line or inside a sentence.

from.quote: Use a Link to send people to related content, such as terms, help, or a recovery step, on its own line or inside a sentence.

avoidWhen.text: The screen's main action: links take people somewhere, so keep the main action a Button.

from.quote: Links take people somewhere. Keep the screen’s main action a Button.

anatomy.holds: The text (text or children); says where the link goes, and its size follows the Text Sizes mode.

from.quote: Says where the link goes; its size follows the Text Sizes mode.

anatomy.holds: Always on; the cue that the words can be pressed.

from.quote: Always on; it is the cue that the words can be pressed.

anatomy.holds: With Fill, the link spans its parent, so the whole row responds to a press.

from.quote: With Fill, the link spans its parent, so the whole row responds to a press.

placementAdvice.text: Inside a sentence, place the Link in a TextSegment: it wraps with the copy and takes its colour and size.

from.quote: Inside a TextSegment the link wraps with the copy and takes its colour and size.

placementAdvice.text: Let the screen open the destination (terms, privacy policy or help) in onPress; Link only reports the press.

from.quote: The screen opens the Terms, Privacy Policy, or help when a link is pressed; Link only reports the press.

placementAdvice.text: The parent sets the width and the type sets the height: a Fill link is as wide as its parent and a Hug link as wide as its words.

from.quote: A Fill link is as wide as its parent and a Hug link as wide as its words.

configuration.text: autolayout Fill with textAlign Left is the default: the label starts at the left and the whole row is pressable.

from.quote: The default. The label starts at the left and the whole row is pressable.

configuration.text: Use textAlign Center with Fill to centre the label, for example under a full-width button.

from.quote: Centres the label, for example under a full-width button.

configuration.text: Use textAlign Center with autolayout Fill: Fill stretches the link across its parent, the only width where Center has room to work.

from.quote: Fill stretches the link across its parent, the only width where Center has room to work.

configuration.text: Use autolayout Hug for a link in a row beside other content; only the words are pressable.

from.quote: Only the words are pressable, for a link in a row beside other content.

configuration.text: Disable a link only while it briefly can't be used, such as Resend code during a countdown.

from.quote: Disable a link only while it briefly can’t be used, such as Resend code during a countdown.

configuration.text: Set the size with the Text Sizes mode: one line is 16, 17 or 24 px tall for Small, Medium and Large; long labels wrap onto more lines.

from.quote: Its height is one line of type: 16, 17, or 24 px for Small, Medium, and Large. Long labels wrap onto more lines.
Links take people somewhere.

rules.text: Write a short label in sentence case that names the destination or task, such as “Forgot PIN?” or “View all transactions”.

from.quote: Write a short label in sentence case that names the destination or task, such as “Forgot PIN?” or “View all transactions”.

rules.text: In a sentence, link only the words that name the destination and keep the punctuation outside.

from.quote: In a sentence, link only the words that name the destination and keep the punctuation outside.

rules.text: Avoid vague labels such as “Click here”.

from.quote: Avoid vague labels such as “Click here”.

rules.text: Do not link the whole sentence: a fully underlined sentence hides what will open.

from.quote: A fully underlined sentence hides what will open.

states.when: The default: full-strength text with its underline.

from.quote: Full-strength text with its underline.

states.when: disabled true: dimmed to 40% and ignores presses; for a link that briefly can't be used.

from.quote: Dimmed to 40% and ignores presses.

accessibility.text: Do not make the main action a link: a 17 px underlined line is easy to miss and hard to tap.

from.quote: A 17 px underlined line is easy to miss and hard to tap.

from.quote: On the web, Enter and Space activate a focused link, and a disabled link is announced as disabled and skipped by Tab.

examples.purpose: Links inside a sentence: only the destinations are links, and the punctuation stays outside.
examples.jsx:
<TextSegment modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}>
  <Text modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}>By continuing you agree to our </Text>
  <Link text="Terms" onPress={() => {}} modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }} />
  <Text modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}> and </Text>
  <Link text="Privacy Policy" onPress={() => {}} modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }} />
  <Text modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}>.</Text>
</TextSegment>

from.quote: In a sentence, link only the words that name the destination and keep the punctuation outside.

<VStack modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}>
  <Button label="Continue" onPress={() => {}} modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }} />
  <Link text="Need help?" autolayout="Fill" textAlign="Center" onPress={() => {}} modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }} />
</VStack>

examples.purpose: A Hug link in a row beside other content.
examples.jsx:
<HStack alignVertical="center" justifyHorizontal="space-between" modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}>
  <Text modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}>Recent transactions</Text>
  <Link text="View all" autolayout="Hug" onPress={() => {}} modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }} />
</HStack>

from.quote: Only the words are pressable, for a link in a row beside other content.

props.name: text
props.description: The link label. You may also pass content as JSX children (e.g. `<Link>Terms</Link>`); when both are provided, `children` wins. Mirrors the {@link Text} API so `Link` is a near-drop-in, underlined sibling of `Text`.

props.name: children
props.description: Child nodes (string or nested `Text`/`Link`). Wins over `text`.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Enter and Space on a focused link both call onPress (#174 fixed). Declared: Called when the link is activated. Navigation is the consumer's job (e.g. `Linking.openURL`, a router push) — `Link` is intentionally navigation-agnostic and React Native friendly (no `href`/`target`).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Opacity 0.4 with onPress suppressed; the link has aria-disabled=true and tabindex=-1, so Tab skips it. Declared: Disables interaction and dims the label. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: autolayout
props.description: Fill is align-self: stretch, so a press on the empty right side of a Fill row fires onPress; Hug is the label's width. In a plain block parent on the web the element is inline and Fill has no effect. Declared: Layout sizing (matches the Figma `autolayout` variant). - `Fill` (default): the label stretches to fill the parent's width, so `textAlign="Center"` is visible and the whole line is tappable. - `Hug`: the label hugs its content width. Default "Fill", from the component source.

props.name: textAlign
props.description: Center shows only with Fill; Hug with Center renders at the left edge. Declared: Horizontal alignment of the label (matches `Text`). Default "Left", from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: Modes configuration for design token resolution (cascades from `TextSegment`).

props.name: numberOfLines
props.description: numberOfLines 1 keeps the label to one line with an ellipsis; without it, long labels wrap. Declared: Number of lines to limit the label to.

props.name: disableTruncation
props.description: Never truncate — drops the clamp/ellipsis and lets the label overflow. See {@link Text}.

props.name: singleLine
props.description: Force a single non-wrapping line (implies `disableTruncation`). See {@link Text}.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label; defaults to the resolved text content.

props.name: accessibilityHint
props.description: Accessibility hint describing what activating the link does.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: Dark leaves text/foreground black: Link (like Text) is not recoloured. Declared: A token collection Link reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Context
modes.description: A token collection Link reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Page type
modes.description: JioPlus gives white link text. Declared: A token collection Link reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Text Appearance
modes.description: Primary is gold rgb(206,161,90), about 2.4:1 on white; Secondary is purple; Error is red. Inside a TextSegment the link takes the paragraph's modes. Declared: A token collection Link reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Text Sizes
modes.description: Small 12/16, Medium 14/17, Large 18/24 px; line boxes 16, 17 and 24 px tall. Declared: A token collection Link reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Weight
modes.description: Regular 400, Medium 500 (the default), Bold 800. Declared: A token collection Link reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

slots.name: children
slots.description: Child nodes (string or nested `Text`/`Link`). Wins over `text`.

events.name: onPress
events.description: Called when the link is activated. Navigation is the consumer's job (e.g. `Linking.openURL`, a router push) — `Link` is intentionally navigation-agnostic and React Native friendly (no `href`/`target`).
